title: Running the XOR gate sequence
statement: Let $vs$ be a list of Boolean values, and let $x,y,L\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $|vs|=L$, $x<L$, and $y<L$. Running the four-gate sequence that computes the OR of the values at $x,y$, their AND, the negation of the value at index $L+1$, and the AND of the values at indices $L,L+2$, starting from $vs$, appends, in order, $vs_x\lor vs_y$, $vs_x\land vs_y$, $\neg(vs_x\land vs_y)$, and $vs_x\mathbin{\mathrm{xor}}vs_y$, where an out-of-range list index has value false.
